content.json:
# GenAI Observability
Cost, token usage, and tool performance across **Azure AI Foundry** and **Microsoft Copilot Studio** telemetry in this Application Insights resource. Token/cost tiles are populated for AI Foundry only — see the gap analysis in the repo. Pick a time range below.

## Telemetry source inventory
Which GenAI telemetry flavours are present (run to confirm your instance).

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| extend cd = customDimensions
| extend genaiSystem = tostring(cd["gen_ai.system"]),
         provider     = tostring(cd["resource.provider"]),
         opName       = tostring(cd["gen_ai.operation.name"])
| extend source = case(
        genaiSystem startswith "az.ai",       "AI Foundry",
        genaiSystem == "openai",              "AI Foundry (OpenAI SDK)",
        provider == "copilot studio",         "Copilot Studio (env OTel)",
        name == "mcp.tool",                   "Copilot Studio (MCP legacy)",
        "Other / unclassified")
| summarize spans = count(),
            withTokens = countif(isnotempty(tostring(cd["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]))),
            distinctModels = dcount(tostring(cd["gen_ai.request.model"])),
            distinctTools  = dcount(coalesce(tostring(cd["gen_ai.tool.name"]), tostring(cd["mcp.tool.name"])))
        by source, genaiSystem, provider
| order by spans desc
content.title: Telemetry source inventory
content.comment: Which GenAI telemetry flavours are present (run to confirm your instance).

content.json:
## Tool invocation frequency & error rate
Per tool, across AI Foundry + Copilot Studio.

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| extend cd = customDimensions
| extend genaiTool = tostring(cd["gen_ai.tool.name"]),
         mcpTool   = tostring(cd["mcp.tool.name"]),
         genaiSystem = tostring(cd["gen_ai.system"]),
         provider    = tostring(cd["resource.provider"]),
         mcpOutcome  = tolower(coalesce(tostring(cd["mcp.tool.outcome"]), tostring(cd["outcome"]), tostring(resultCode)))
| where isnotempty(genaiTool) or isnotempty(mcpTool)
        or name in ("ExecuteTool", "mcp.tool")
        or tostring(cd["gen_ai.operation.name"]) == "execute_tool"
| extend toolName = iif(isnotempty(genaiTool), genaiTool,
                    iif(isnotempty(mcpTool), mcpTool, name))
| extend source = case(
        genaiSystem startswith "az.ai" or genaiSystem == "openai", "AI Foundry",
        provider == "copilot studio",                              "Copilot Studio (env OTel)",
        name == "mcp.tool",                                        "Copilot Studio (MCP legacy)",
        isnotempty(genaiTool),                                     "AI Foundry",
        "Other")
| extend isError = (success == false) or (resultCode == "ERROR")
                   or (mcpOutcome in ("error", "failure", "failed"))
| summarize invocations = count(),
            errors      = countif(isError),
            avgDurationMs = round(avg(duration), 1)
        by source, toolName
| extend errorRatePct = round(100.0 * errors / invocations, 2)
| order by invocations desc
content.title: Tool invocation frequency & error rate
content.comment: Per tool, across AI Foundry + Copilot Studio.

content.json:
## Token usage by model (daily)
AI Foundry only — Copilot Studio does not log tokens.

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| extend cd = customDimensions
| extend inTok  = tolong(cd["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]),
         outTok = tolong(cd["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"])
| where isnotnull(inTok) or isnotnull(outTok)
| extend model = iif(isnotempty(tostring(cd["gen_ai.response.model"])),
                     tostring(cd["gen_ai.response.model"]),
                     tostring(cd["gen_ai.request.model"]))
| extend model = iif(isnotempty(model), model, "unknown")
| summarize inputTokens  = sum(inTok),
            outputTokens = sum(outTok),
            calls        = count()
        by day = bin(timestamp, 1d), model
| extend totalTokens = inputTokens + outputTokens
| order by day asc, totalTokens desc
content.title: Token usage by model (daily)
content.comment: AI Foundry only — Copilot Studio does not log tokens.

content.json:
## Tool latency p50 / p95 / p99 (ms)
Per tool; duration is milliseconds.

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| extend cd = customDimensions
| extend genaiTool = tostring(cd["gen_ai.tool.name"]),
         mcpTool   = tostring(cd["mcp.tool.name"]),
         genaiSystem = tostring(cd["gen_ai.system"]),
         provider    = tostring(cd["resource.provider"])
| where isnotempty(genaiTool) or isnotempty(mcpTool)
        or name in ("ExecuteTool", "mcp.tool")
        or tostring(cd["gen_ai.operation.name"]) == "execute_tool"
| extend toolName = iif(isnotempty(genaiTool), genaiTool,
                    iif(isnotempty(mcpTool), mcpTool, name))
| extend source = case(
        genaiSystem startswith "az.ai" or genaiSystem == "openai", "AI Foundry",
        provider == "copilot studio",                              "Copilot Studio (env OTel)",
        name == "mcp.tool",                                        "Copilot Studio (MCP legacy)",
        isnotempty(genaiTool),                                     "AI Foundry",
        "Other")
| summarize calls = count(),
            p50Ms = round(percentile(duration, 50), 1),
            p95Ms = round(percentile(duration, 95), 1),
            p99Ms = round(percentile(duration, 99), 1),
            maxMs = round(max(duration), 1)
        by source, toolName
| order by p95Ms desc
content.title: Tool latency p50 / p95 / p99 (ms)

content.json:
## Estimated cost per conversation (USD)
AI Foundry only. Update the pricing datatable in the .kql.

content.query:
let pricing = datatable(model:string, inPer1M:real, outPer1M:real) [
    "gpt-4o",        2.50, 10.00,
    "gpt-4o-mini",   0.15,  0.60,
    "gpt-4.1",       2.00,  8.00,
    "gpt-4.1-mini",  0.40,  1.60,
    "gpt-4.1-nano",  0.10,  0.40,
    "o3",           10.00, 40.00,
    "o3-mini",       1.10,  4.40,
    "o1",           15.00, 60.00,
    "o1-mini",       1.10,  4.40
];
dependencies
| where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| extend cd = customDimensions
| extend inTok  = tolong(cd["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]),
         outTok = tolong(cd["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"])
| where isnotnull(inTok) or isnotnull(outTok)
| extend rawModel = iif(isnotempty(tostring(cd["gen_ai.response.model"])),
                        tostring(cd["gen_ai.response.model"]),
                        tostring(cd["gen_ai.request.model"]))
| extend convId = tostring(cd["gen_ai.conversation.id"])
| extend convId = iif(isnotempty(convId), convId, tostring(cd["gen_ai.thread.id"]))
| extend convId = iif(isnotempty(convId), convId, tostring(operation_Id))
| extend model = case(
        rawModel startswith "gpt-4o-mini",  "gpt-4o-mini",
        rawModel startswith "gpt-4o",       "gpt-4o",
        rawModel startswith "gpt-4.1-nano", "gpt-4.1-nano",
        rawModel startswith "gpt-4.1-mini", "gpt-4.1-mini",
        rawModel startswith "gpt-4.1",      "gpt-4.1",
        rawModel startswith "o3-mini",      "o3-mini",
        rawModel startswith "o1-mini",      "o1-mini",
        rawModel startswith "o3",           "o3",
        rawModel startswith "o1",           "o1",
        rawModel)
| join kind=leftouter pricing on model
| extend estCostUsd = coalesce(inTok, 0) / 1000000.0 * coalesce(inPer1M, 0.0)
                    + coalesce(outTok, 0) / 1000000.0 * coalesce(outPer1M, 0.0)
| summarize inputTokens  = sum(inTok),
            outputTokens = sum(outTok),
            estCostUsd   = round(sum(estCostUsd), 4),
            calls        = count(),
            pricedCalls  = countif(isnotnull(inPer1M)),
            models       = make_set(model)
        by convId
| extend totalTokens = inputTokens + outputTokens
| order by estCostUsd desc
content.title: Estimated cost per conversation (USD)
content.comment: AI Foundry only. Update the pricing datatable in the .kql.
